source_detail: Built in ca-tools 2026-11-13 from the table's own CA(49;3,352,2) (Power CT over GF(11), row S7, file table/arrays/CA_49_3_352_2.txt). Its blocks of 11, 11, 11 and 6 rows, in which a column shows one of 11, 11, 11 or 4 patterns, are reused, and its block of 10 rows is replaced by a new block of 8 rows with 5 patterns found by one SAT call (programs/blk.py 8 5). A column is a word over alphabets of sizes 11, 11, 11, 5 and 4; in every block any three distinct patterns show all non-constant triples, so a set of words is a strength-3 covering array if and only if no word agrees coordinate by coordinate with one of two other words (programs/build.py checks this). Words (t, t+u, t+v, x, y) over Z11 with five points (u, v) in slab (0, 0) and one point in each of the other 19 slabs (x, y), placed by one CaDiCaL 1.5.3 call through python-sat 1.9.dev22 on the line rules forced by the condition (programs/lin3.py 5 4 5 24, deterministic), give 264 words. programs/recipe.sh runs it; two runs from scratch gave the same array (programs/recipe_log.txt). Exact check with ca_verify, all 3-sets
construction: Words over row blocks of the Power CT CA(49;3,352,2) and a new block of 8 rows with 5 patterns, designed as lines of Z11 x Z11 with five points in one slab, placed by exact SAT
